name: Women’s Black Block Heel Sandals with Sparkling Rhinestone Straps | Elegant Party & Casual Footwear
description:
Add a touch of glamour to your step with these beautifully designed black block heel sandals. Featuring a sparkling rhinestone-embellished strap, these sandals bring sophistication and shine to your evening or special occasion outfits.
Designed with comfort and elegance in mind, the cushioned footbed ensures a soft feel with every step, while the sturdy block heel offers balance and support. The open-toe design allows breathability, making them ideal for warmer weather or long events.
The standout feature is the delicately crafted T-strap lined with shimmering rhinestones, giving your look a chic upgrade—perfect for weddings, parties, dinners, or festive celebrations. The ankle strap ensures a snug fit without compromising style.
 Key Features:
Elegant rhinestone-studded T-strap design
Comfortable mid-height block heel
Soft cushioned footbed for extended wear
Open toe with wide front strap for added support
Ideal for party, wedding, or festive wear
Lightweight and easy to slip on/off
